page.overview:
What is Callidora Black?

Callidora Longbottom (née Black) (b. 1915) was a pure-blood witch and a member of the noble House of Black. She was the eldest daughter of Arcturus Black (II) and Lysandra Yaxley and the oldest sister of Cedrella and Charis.

She married Harfang Longbottom, and the couple had two children, a son and a daughter.

She was related to the Crouch and Weasley families through her sisters, and was related to the Longbottoms through marriage. She is likely to have been related to Mr Longbottom and his son and grandson.
